goal: Is ke baad aap case, break aur default ke saath switch menu likh sakenge, fall-through samjha sakenge, aur jaan sakenge ke kab us ki jagah if-else-if use karna chahiye.
warmup: Canteen ke counter par menu board laga hai: 1 dabayein biryani ke liye, 2 karahi ke liye, 3 chai ke liye. Cashier range check nahi karti aur koi hisaab nahi lagati. Woh bas aap ka number dekhti hai aur seedha menu ki us line par chali jati hai. Agar aap ka number board par nahi hai to woh kehti hai 'sorry, not available'. Switch isi menu board ki tarah kaam karta hai: ek value, aur seedha matching choice par jump.
definition: Switch statement ek expression ko fixed values se compare karke code ka ek block chunta hai, jin ko cases kehte hain. Expression integer type ya char honi chahiye (double nahi, string nahi). Har case value constant honi chahiye aur doosron se alag. Switch sirf equality test karta hai, is liye woh marks >= 50 jaisi ranges test nahi kar sakta.
howItWorks: Play dabayein, ya visualizer mein value badlein. Computer expression ko ek dafa evaluate karta hai, wahi value wala case dhoondta hai, aur us par jump karta hai. Phir woh wahan se har statement run karta jata hai jab tak break ya closing brace na aa jaye. Isi liye break zaroori hai: iske baghair computer agle case mein bhi chalta rehta hai. Isey fall-through kehte hain. Agar koi case match na kare, to default block run hota hai. default optional hai aur aam tor par aakhir mein likha jata hai.
